stretch of the River Liffey near Islandbridge, is home to over 13 Rowing Clubs – one of which belongs to Dublin City Council. In order to link the eastern length of the Liffey from Islandbridge, the Community, Culture and Local Area Services Department of Dublin City Council has obtained planning permission for an access walkway and pontoon to be constructed on one of the small islands east of the weir. This will allow rowers starting at Islandbridge to have access down to Ringsend and vice versa safely. The project comprises a pontoon with associated walkways to facilitate access to the river for rowing boats and kayaks. The project will provide for a platform that would minimize damage to bankside vegetation when launching and retrieving boats and allow a safe platform for kayakers and boaters to embark and disembark. The Islandbridge location has extensive heritage and ecology. In keeping with this, minimal deviation from the existing design and methodology is required to comply with planning regulations. The works proposed plan to combine the following elements: a) A floating pontoon system within the River Liffey anchored to the existing island shore. b) A new stone and concrete platform built out from the riverbank and connected to the pontoon by a new gangway. c) The removal of vegetation on approach to the pontoon and installation of a new access walkway from the south upper River Liffey at the weir to the new pontoon located north on the lower River Liffey. d) The temporary removal, refurbishment and reinstatement of an existing steel footbridge located on the island. e) The removal of poor existing vegetation, pruning of existing healthy trees and the replanting of 25 new high-quality trees and growing shrubs all native to Ireland. f) Temporary regrading of land during site works for access onto the island. . Please note that this project is subject to funding. description: The Energy Efficient Design (EED) process is intended to ensure that the Contracting Authority’s capital projects are conducted in accordance with objective and methodical protocols and procedures. The overall EED process comprises organisational measures, processes, guiding principles and control mechanisms to be implemented during the design of projects, with the targets of (i) reducing the lifecycle energy consumption and GHG emissions of the building when in use and (ii) achieving a building that is Carbon Zero Ready (i.e., a building that will be carbon zero when the electrical grid decarbonises). In accordance with national and sectoral guidance, the EED process shall be applied to all projects with a value greater than €1,000,000. The purpose of this competition is to appoint a suitably-qualified and experienced EED Facilitator who will draft and submit key EED reports in accordance with this Specification of Requirements document. Such reports will serve to measure progress of the EED process as applied to each capital project and effectively communicate the results of the EED process to Contracting Authority project stakeholders.

Title: Ireland – Medical hospital services – Multi-Party Framework Agreement for the Provision of a Non-Operative Treatment Pathway for Low Complexity Spinal Patients
Procedure title: Multi-Party Framework Agreement for the Provision of a Non-Operative Treatment Pathway for Low Complexity Spinal Patients
Description: The Contracting Authority intends to establish a framework agreement with suitably-qualified and experienced medical service providers to deliver end-to-end outpatient assessment, diagnostic and non-operative treatment pathways for a cohort of approximately 1,200 patients. These patients are currently on a neurosurgical waiting list, rather than an orthopaedic list; however, the Contracting Authority will accept tender submissions involving orthopaedic spinal surgeon review. For tenderers’ information, a low-complexity spine patient is defined as an individual with a straightforward, one or two level or localised spinal condition that requires standard surgical or medical management with minimal technical difficulty and lower physiological risk. Under the framework agreement, the successful tenderers will assume responsibility for patients from the first specialist outpatient assessment to the patient’s discharge or until a determination has been made that surgical intervention is clinically indicated. It is a mandatory condition for the operation of this framework agreement that appointed framework operators are eligible to deliver low-complexity spine procedures under the relevant National Surgical Services Framework.

For tenderers’ information, a low-complexity spine patient is defined as an individual with a straightforward, one or two level or localised spinal condition that requires standard surgical or medical management with minimal technical difficulty and lower physiological risk. Under the framework agreement, the successful tenderers will assume responsibility for patients from the first specialist outpatient assessment to the patient’s discharge or until a determination has been made that surgical intervention is clinically indicated. It is a mandatory condition for the operation of this framework agreement that appointed framework operators are eligible to deliver low-complexity spine procedures under the relevant National Surgical Services Framework.

description: Uisce Eireann is seeking to establish a high-quality sampling and or analysis service to achieve efficiencies in all commercial laboratory contractual arrangements, to meet regulatory requirements, and to protect public health. These services will be sub-divided into Three (3) Lots described below as Lot 1, Lot 2 and Lot 3. Applicants may apply for one, some or all Lots. For Lots 1, 2 and 3 the successful tenderers may be allocated as preferred supplier for a Geographical Region or Regions on the basis of their tenders and there may be a limit on the number of Regions for which a single supplier achieves preferred supplier status. It is anticipated that Uisce Eireann will enter into separate framework agreements for each of the following Lots: Lot 1 - Potable Water Laboratory Testing Services. Uisce Eireann require potable water laboratory testing services for the following sampling categories: • PLANNED (Drinking Water Directive – Schedule 1 and Schedule 2) • UNPLANNED (Investigative; Short term requests e.g. EPA) • EMERGENCY. For each of the categories above, Uisce Eireann may require a combination of Sampling and Testing services (i.e. taking the sample, transport to the supplier’s laboratory, analysis and reporting), a Collection and Testing service (i.e. collection of sample(s) from a designated collection point(s), transport to the supplier’s laboratory, analysis and reporting) and Testing Only (receipt of samples delivered to the suppliers laboratory analysis and reporting). With regards to the PLANNED, UNPLANNED, and EMERGENCY categories, Uisce Eireann may also require sampling and/or testing of raw water (i.e. ground water or surface water), and In-Process Water (i.e. samples taken from locations within the treatment process). Additional Services may be procured through the course of the framework to facilitate various investigative activities including but not limited to the following areas of work:- • Process Optimisation • Process Proving / Commissioning These additional services may be PLANNED or UNPLANNED in nature. Lot 2: Provision of Wastewater Laboratory Testing Services. Uisce Eireann require wastewater laboratory testing services for the following sampling categories: • PLANNED (Wastewater Regulatory Sampling Plans ) • UNPLANNED (Investigative; Short term requests e.g. EPA) • EMERGENCY. For each of the categories above, Uisce Eireann may require a combination of Sampling and Testing services (i.e. taking the sample, transport to the supplier’s laboratory, analysis and reporting), a Collection and Testing service (i.e. collection of sample(s) from a designated collection point(s), transport to the supplier’s laboratory, analysis and reporting) and Testing Only (receipt of samples delivered to the suppliers laboratory analysis and reporting). The applicant should also have the capability to undertake analysis of samples from saline waters. With regards to the PLANNED, UNPLANNED, and EMERGENCY categories, Uisce Eireann may also require sampling and/or testing of In-Process Wastewater (i.e. samples taken from locations within the treatment process). Additional Services may be procured through the course of the framework to facilitate various investigative activities including but not limited to the following areas of work:- • Process Optimisation • Process Proving / Commissioning • Flow and Load Surveys • Sludge Testing These additional services may be PLANNED or UNPLANNED in nature. Lot 3: Provision of Contingency outsourcing of Laboratory Testing Services. Uisce Eireann require the provision of Drinking Water and Wastewater contingency and surge laboratory testing services to maintain continuity during equipment failure, accreditation loss, or capacity constraints.

Procedure title: 26-007F National Multi-Supplier Framework for the Provision of Laboratory Services
Description: Uisce Eireann is seeking to establish a high-quality sampling and or analysis service to achieve efficiencies in all commercial laboratory contractual arrangements, to meet regulatory requirements, and to protect public health. These services will be sub-divided into Three (3) Lots described below as Lot 1, Lot 2 and Lot 3. Applicants may apply for one, some or all Lots. For Lots 1, 2 and 3 the successful tenderers may be allocated as preferred supplier for a Geographical Region or Regions on the basis of their tenders and there may be a limit on the number of Regions for which a single supplier achieves preferred supplier status. It is anticipated that Uisce Eireann will enter into separate framework agreements for each of the following Lots: Lot 1 - Potable Water Laboratory Testing Services. Uisce Eireann require potable water laboratory testing services for the following sampling categories: • PLANNED (Drinking Water Directive – Schedule 1 and Schedule 2) • UNPLANNED (Investigative; Short term requests e.g. EPA) • EMERGENCY. For each of the categories above, Uisce Eireann may require a combination of Sampling and Testing services (i.e. taking the sample, transport to the supplier’s laboratory, analysis and reporting), a Collection and Testing service (i.e. collection of sample(s) from a designated collection point(s), transport to the supplier’s laboratory, analysis and reporting) and Testing Only (receipt of samples delivered to the suppliers laboratory analysis and reporting). With regards to the PLANNED, UNPLANNED, and EMERGENCY categories, Uisce Eireann may also require sampling and/or testing of raw water (i.e. ground water or surface water), and In-Process Water (i.e. samples taken from locations within the treatment process). Additional Services may be procured through the course of the framework to facilitate various investigative activities including but not limited to the following areas of work:- • Process Optimisation • Process Proving / Commissioning These additional services may be PLANNED or UNPLANNED in nature. Lot 2: Provision of Wastewater Laboratory Testing Services. Uisce Eireann require wastewater laboratory testing services for the following sampling categories: • PLANNED (Wastewater Regulatory Sampling Plans ) • UNPLANNED (Investigative; Short term requests e.g. EPA) • EMERGENCY. For each of the categories above, Uisce Eireann may require a combination of Sampling and Testing services (i.e. taking the sample, transport to the supplier’s laboratory, analysis and reporting), a Collection and Testing service (i.e. collection of sample(s) from a designated collection point(s), transport to the supplier’s laboratory, analysis and reporting) and Testing Only (receipt of samples delivered to the suppliers laboratory analysis and reporting). The applicant should also have the capability to undertake analysis of samples from saline waters. With regards to the PLANNED, UNPLANNED, and EMERGENCY categories, Uisce Eireann may also require sampling and/or testing of In-Process Wastewater (i.e. samples taken from locations within the treatment process). Additional Services may be procured through the course of the framework to facilitate various investigative activities including but not limited to the following areas of work:- • Process Optimisation • Process Proving / Commissioning • Flow and Load Surveys • Sludge Testing These additional services may be PLANNED or UNPLANNED in nature. Lot 3: Provision of Contingency outsourcing of Laboratory Testing Services. Uisce Eireann require the provision of Drinking Water and Wastewater contingency and surge laboratory testing services to maintain continuity during equipment failure, accreditation loss, or capacity constraints.

Procedure title: TR5801 - Leadership, Culture and Organisational Capability Services Framework
Description: ESB intends to establish a multi-party Framework Agreement for the provision of Leadership, Culture and Organisational Capability Services to support the delivery of ESB's Culture and Capability Strategy. The Framework Agreement will provide access to expert service providers to support the co-design, development, deployment and ongoing evolution of Culture and Capability initiatives across ESB. The proposed scope includes the following service areas: Employee and Manager Capability Development; Leadership Development; Strategic Workforce Planning and Talent Management; Digital, Data and AI; and Organisation Development, Change Management, Culture and Future of Work.. Applicants are not required to demonstrate expertise across all service areas. Applicants may demonstrate relevant experience and capability within one or more areas of the overall Framework scope. The Framework Agreement will have an initial term of three years. The Contracting Entity reserves the right to extend the Framework Agreement for further period or periods, up to a maximum total Framework Agreement duration of eight years.

description: The development is located on the existing site of the Maternity Hospital at UMHL delivering acute hospital services and will consist of a new rapid build facility with a gross internal floor area of circa. 863m2. The proposed development includes two floors (ground, first), plus a rooftop plantroom area of circa. 150m2. The development also consists of the refurbishment of the existing Main Entrance and Medical Emergency Unit (area circa. 263m2). The development will provide for the refurbishment of the main hospital reception, the expansion and refurbishment of the existing Maternity Emergency Unit, a new extension providing a diagnostic scanning suite, a 3 bed assessment unit on the ground floor, a 4 bed labour induction unit, a 2 room Intensive Care suite and a Procedure room on the first floor along with general support and staff facilities. The development also includes a new main entrance draught lobby and entrance canopy along with an upgraded Main Entrance forecourt with associated landscape works. It is proposed to construct a new car park to the south east of the site for car parking displaced by the new development and associated landscape works.

Procedure title: EST_MW - Maternity Emergency and Early Pregnancy Assessment Unit - University Maternity Hospital Limerick
Description: The development is located on the existing site of the Maternity Hospital at UMHL delivering acute hospital services and will consist of a new rapid build facility with a gross internal floor area of circa. 863m2. The proposed development includes two floors (ground, first), plus a rooftop plantroom area of circa. 150m2. The development also consists of the refurbishment of the existing Main Entrance and Medical Emergency Unit (area circa. 263m2). The development will provide for the refurbishment of the main hospital reception, the expansion and refurbishment of the existing Maternity Emergency Unit, a new extension providing a diagnostic scanning suite, a 3 bed assessment unit on the ground floor, a 4 bed labour induction unit, a 2 room Intensive Care suite and a Procedure room on the first floor along with general support and staff facilities. The development also includes a new main entrance draught lobby and entrance canopy along with an upgraded Main Entrance forecourt with associated landscape works. It is proposed to construct a new car park to the south east of the site for car parking displaced by the new development and associated landscape works.

The development also includes a new main entrance draught lobby and entrance canopy along with an upgraded Main Entrance forecourt with associated landscape works. It is proposed to construct a new car park to the south east of the site for car parking displaced by the new development and associated landscape works.

Title: Ireland – Engineering services – Killeen and Feenune Bridge Barrier Mitigation Project
Procedure title: Killeen and Feenune Bridge Barrier Mitigation Project
Description: Inland Fisheries Ireland is seeking to procure multidisciplinary consultancy services to assist with the delivery of two Barrier Mitigation Projects: Killeen Bridge and Feenune Bridge near Louisburgh in Co. Mayo, through the completion of Phases 1 to 3. The appointed Consultant will undertake all necessary engineering, environmental and planning services required to progress the project through feasibility, option selection, and statutory consent stages in accordance with the Planning and Development Acts 2000–2023, the Capital Works Management Framework, and Infrastructure Guidelines 2023. The Barrier Mitigation Projects aim to mitigate the impacts of the identified barriers on fish passage and restore more natural river processes along the associated rivers. The commission forms a specific action under Ireland’s Water Action Plan 2024 and supports implementation of the National Barrier Mitigation Programme to deliver improved ecological status under the EU Water Framework Directive. The Consultant will act as the Designer, Project Supervisor Design Process during Phases 1 to 3 of the project and carry out all related necessary duties.

The appointed Consultant will undertake all necessary engineering, environmental and planning services required to progress the project through feasibility, option selection, and statutory consent stages in accordance with the Planning and Development Acts 2000–2023, the Capital Works Management Framework, and Infrastructure Guidelines 2023. The Barrier Mitigation Projects aim to mitigate the impacts of the identified barriers on fish passage and restore more natural river processes along the associated rivers. The commission forms a specific action under Ireland’s Water Action Plan 2024 and supports implementation of the National Barrier Mitigation Programme to deliver improved ecological status under the EU Water Framework Directive. The Consultant will act as the Designer, Project Supervisor Design Process during Phases 1 to 3 of the project and carry out all related necessary duties.

Description: The successful Tenderer must design and administer in consultation with the Department of Enterprise, Tourism and Employment, an effective, efficient and fair recruitment and selection process for the Department, in line with the Commission for Public Service Code of Practice for appointments to positions in the Civil and Public Service. description: This is a call for competition by Iarnród Éireann for the procurement of an experienced Design and Build Contractor to complete the design and deliver capacity enhancement and transformation works at Connolly Station. The project will create a new entrance from Preston Street and a passenger concourse within the historic Victorian undercroft, together with new lifts, escalators and staircases providing improved access to Platforms 5, 6 and 7. The works will also include additional emergency escape routes, public-realm improvements, retail, operational and back-of-house spaces, heritage refurbishment, structural alterations and the installation or modification of station and railway systems. The successful Contractor will be required to review and develop the reference design through detailed design to Approved for Construction status and subsequently construct, test and commission the works. The Contractor will also be responsible for providing complete as-built and handover information. The project will be delivered within a constrained, live operational railway environment. The Contractor will be required to manage passenger circulation, railway access, construction phasing, safety assurance, stakeholder engagement, heritage requirements and interfaces with other DART+ contracts. The appointed Contractor will undertake the role of Project Supervisor for the Construction Stage. The form of contract is currently anticipated to be the NEC4 Engineering and Construction Contract, Option C, target contract with activity schedule. This procurement is a reissue of an earlier competition published in May 2025 under procedure identifier e342e2b9-7827-4a53-81b6-5178881e0fa0 and eTenders reference ID 5643930, which was subsequently discontinued without the award of a contract.

Procedure title: T.083.2026 Request for Tenders to establish a Single-Supplier Framework for the provision of Temporary CCTV and related Services for Special Events as a Managed Service, for An Garda Síochána
Description: In summary, the services requested comprise of the provision of temporary CCTV and related Services for outdoor Special Events and VIP Visits as a Managed Service. The Contracting Authority will require the successful Tenderer to have the ability to provide services they are tendering for within short notice i.e. 48 hours. The Contracting Authority will establish a single-supplier framework for the provision of the following services individually or in combination to support policing operations during special events (including VIP visits): • The provision of CCTV Services (including the provision, installation and maintenance of cameras, video links, and a video evidence management solution); • The provision of a communications vehicle (or vehicles) with equipment necessary to provide control room functionality and to support incident management); • The provision of large (outdoor) video displays; and, • The provision of a public announcement (“PA”) system (or systems). The successful Tenderer will be responsible for sourcing and providing the equipment listed above along with the provision of ancillary services and equipment necessary to provide the equipment above as a managed service.

The Contracting Authority will establish a single-supplier framework for the provision of the following services individually or in combination to support policing operations during special events (including VIP visits): • The provision of CCTV Services (including the provision, installation and maintenance of cameras, video links, and a video evidence management solution); • The provision of a communications vehicle (or vehicles) with equipment necessary to provide control room functionality and to support incident management); • The provision of large (outdoor) video displays; and, • The provision of a public announcement (“PA”) system (or systems). Title: Ireland – Legal advisory services – Establishment of a Multi-Party Framework Agreement for Fitness to Practise Legal Services
Procedure title: Establishment of a Multi-Party Framework Agreement for Fitness to Practise Legal Services
Description: NMBI wishes to establish a Multi-Party Framework Agreement for Fitness to Practise Legal Services. The primary role of the legal firm(s) engaged under this procurement process will be to prepare and present cases on behalf of the CEO with respect to registrants who have been referred to inquiry. The responsibilities will also include liaison and collaboration with all participants in the inquiry process (complainants, factual and expert witnesses, registrants, their legal counsel and the Contracting Authority staff). The legal firm will oversee and guide the progression of an inquiry to a timely conclusion. Following an inquiry where a sanction is recommended and subsequently imposed on a registrant by the Board, the legal firm will be responsible for seeking High Court Confirmation of sanction where required in accordance with the Nurses and Midwives Act 2011. Further detail as to required services is set out in three phases – before, during and after an inquiry when the Board decides to impose a sanction which requires High Court confirmation in accordance with the Nurses and Midwives Act 2011.

The legal firm will oversee and guide the progression of an inquiry to a timely conclusion. Following an inquiry where a sanction is recommended and subsequently imposed on a registrant by the Board, the legal firm will be responsible for seeking High Court Confirmation of sanction where required in accordance with the Nurses and Midwives Act 2011. Further detail as to required services is set out in three phases – before, during and after an inquiry when the Board decides to impose a sanction which requires High Court confirmation in accordance with the Nurses and Midwives Act 2011.

Title: Ireland – Construction work – Schools Energy Pathfinder 2025/2026 – Heat Pump Programme – Works Contractors Notice
Procedure title: Schools Energy Pathfinder 2025/2026 – Heat Pump Programme – Works Contractors Notice
Description: Call for Tender for the procurement of Works Contractors for mechanical and electrical plantroom works including all associated builder’s works and site works to facilitate heat pump installation to 17 school buildings located in five counties namely Kildare, Offaly, Laois, Waterford and Wexford. The 17 schools have been divided into eight LOTs comprising of either two or three schools per LOT. An interested Contractor may tender for one or all LOTs, but is restricted to winning a maximum of four LOTs. The Department of Education and Youth (DEY) is publishing this CFT on behalf of the respective Education and Training Boards who will act as the respective Contracting Authorities per LOT. Refer to the Master Project Information Memorandum for further details.

description: The Contracting Authority, Dublin City Council, intends to establish a Single Party Framework Agreement with a Integrated Design Team to deliver planning, engineering, environmental, stakeholder engagement and other specialist consultancy services for the Clontarf Flood Defence and Public Realm Project (CFDPRP). The Project is located along the Clontarf waterfront in Dublin and encompasses a highly sensitive coastal environment adjoining designated European sites, including Special Areas of Conservation (SAC) and Special Protection Areas (SPA). The Project has been initiated to address existing and future coastal and surface water flood risks while delivering a coordinated programme of public realm enhancement, active travel improvements and environmental benefits. The scheme shall be developed through an integrated design approach that balances flood resilience, climate adaptation, biodiversity, heritage, placemaking, sustainable mobility, environmental protection and stakeholder aspirations. The initial call-off contract under the Framework will require the successful Applicant to undertake all services necessary to develop the Project from commencement through option identification, scheme development, environmental assessment, statutory consent processes and detailed design. This shall include the preparation of all technical studies, surveys, modelling, assessments, reports, designs and application documentation required to secure the necessary approvals and to progress the Project to a stage suitable for procurement and construction. The Framework Agreement may subsequently be utilised by the Contracting Authority to procure additional related services, including procurement support, construction-stage services, post-consent services and other specialist consultancy services associated with the delivery of the Project. The successful Applicant shall be required to develop a fully integrated and coordinated scheme that delivers flood protection, surface water management, active travel and public realm objectives within a single coherent design solution that is environmentally sensitive, climate resilient and appropriate to the strategic importance of the Clontarf waterfront. For further information please refer to documentation available to download from www.etenders.gov.ie Resource ID 9181107. Please note that this project is subject to funding.

description: MULTI-PARTY FRAMEWORK AGREEMENT FOR HSE DESIGN TEAM SERVICES FRAMEWORK 2024 – FRAMEWORK 02: ACUTE HEALTHCARE CAPITAL WORKS – PROJECT VALUE €1M -€15M EXCL. VAT. This framework will include the following design team disciplines (Lots): Lot 1: Architect(AR) as Principal Service Provider with the following Specialists domestic sub-consultants, or in-house specialisms: a. Planner (PL), b. Project Supervisor Design Process (PSDP), c. Fire Safety Consultant (FSC) and d. BIM Information Manager(BIM). Lot 2: Quantity Surveyor (QS), as Principal Service Provider. Lot 3: Building Services Engineer (M+E), as Principal Service Provider. Lot 4: Civil / Structural Engineer (C+S), as Principal Service Provider. Lot 5: Employer’s Representative (ER),as Principal Service Provider. Lot 6: Energy Efficient Design Facilitator (EEDF), as Principal Service Provider. Lot 7: Assigned Certifier (AC), as Principal Service Provider. The Health Services Executive (HSE) invites expressions of interest, under the Restricted Procedure, from suitably qualified services providers for the provision of design team services (including Specialist Skills Providers) per the above Lot listing for which it is proposed to establish a Multi-Party Framework Agreement for each Lot type to award call-off contracts for Acute Healthcare Capital Works – project value €1M-€15M excl. VAT within HSE North West Area Please note that the INITIAL project forming Framework 02 for this regional / sub¬regional office NW West Area will be: Proposed Microbiology Lab incorporating ancillary site works, plus enabling work to divert existing services at Sligo University Hospital. Please see SAQ document pack.

Procedure title: Green Capital Grant - Technical Assessments
Description: IDA Ireland supports eligible client sustainability investments through its Green Capital programme. As part of IDA Ireland’s investment approval process for Green Capital projects, an independent technical assessment is required to review the technical basis of each project and to validate or re-quantify its expected environmental impact. To date, technical assessments have been completed by a number of different assessors. As the volume and range of Green Capital investments increase, IDA Ireland requires a more consistent and scalable framework to support these technical reviews. IDA Ireland is seeking to appoint one service provider with the capability to manage and deliver all IDA Green Capital Technical Assessment services covered by this RFT. These will cover pre-investment technical assessments and post-investment Measurement and Verification (M and V) assessments.

These will cover pre-investment technical assessments and post-investment Measurement and Verification (M and V) assessments.

description: CINECA Consorzio Interuniversitario in veste di stazione appaltante delegata da parte dell’Istituto Nazionale di Oceanografia e di Geofisica Sperimentale e dall’Istituto Nazionale di Geofisica e Vulcanologia, intende procedere, in applicazione dell’art. 62, comma 14, d.lgs. 36/2023, all’acquisizione di un sistema che erogherà servizi di calcolo ad alte prestazioni e di virtualizzazione per le infrastrutture di ricerca e per la comunità di utenti CINECA, affiancando e complementando il sistema adacloud (https://adacloud.hpc.cineca.it/) e i sistemi HPC Tier0 e Tier1 già operativi. Progettualità cui si accede: • PNRR - Investimento 3.1 “Fondo per la realizzazione di un sistema integrato di infrastrutture di ricerca e innovazione” nell’ambito della Missione 4 Componente 2, in cui convergono i progetti “Terabit network for Research and Academic Big data in Italy” (CUP I53C21000370006) e “MEET – Monitoring Earth’s Evolution and Tectonics” (CUP D53C22001400005); • PNRR - Investimento 1.4 “Potenziamento strutture di ricerca e creazione di campioni nazionali di R&S su alcune Key Enabling Technologies”, nell’ambito della Missione 4 Componente 2, a cui accede il progetto “National Centre for HPC, Big Data and Quantum Computing”, relativo all’Area Tematica: “Simulazioni, calcolo e analisi dei dati ad alte prestazioni” (CUP D56G22000380006); • PNC - Iniziativa “Digital Driven Diagnostics, prognostics and therapeutics for sustainable Health care” identificata con codice PNC0000001 (Avviso D.D. 931 DEL 06.06.2022) nell'ambito della fondazione “Digital Driven Diagnostics, prognostics and therapeutics for sustainable Health care – Fondazione “D3 4 Health” (CUP B53C22005960001)

Da svolgersi nelle seguenti sedi: Residenza L'Orientale, in Via Brin 65c/67 Napoli (NA), per complessivi n. 144 posti alloggio; Residenza Parthenope, in Via Galileo Ferraris 273 Napoli (NA), per complessivi n. 180 posti alloggio; Residenza Aversa (al momento non attiva), in Via Castello nr. 24 Aversa (CE), per complessivi n. 46 posti alloggio; Residenza Paolella (al momento non attiva), in Via Tansillo 28 Napoli (NA) , per complessivi n. 94 posti alloggio; Residenza De Amicis (al momento non attiva), in Via Tommaso De Amicis, 111 Napoli NA, per complessivi n. 114 posti alloggio.

Lotto 3 - Fornitura n. 2.280 fototrappole con accessori connessi necessari al loro funzionamento (n. 2280 box di sicurezza con lucchetto, n. 4.560 schede SD, n. 54.720 batterie ricaricabili AA, n. 342 caricabatterie multislot); n. 58 di videocamere remotabili; N. 2.940 cassette nido e 4.000 footprint tunnels. Lotto 5 - Fornitura n. 143 GPS portatili satellitari.

Lotto 5 - Fornitura n. 143 GPS portatili satellitari.

Description: L'Azienda Ospedale-Università Padova utilizza i software applicativi della Dedalus S.p.A. per la gestione completa della cartella clinica informatizzata (Galileo), dei laboratori specialistici (Microbiologia), delle attività di consulenza, del pagamento online delle prestazioni SSN e del portale referti. In vista dell'avvio del Sistema Informativo Ospedaliero (SIO) regionale, previsto in primavera 2026, si rende necessario garantire la manutenzione e l’assistenza degli applicativi attualmente in uso per un periodo di 12 mesi con opzione di proroga per ulteriori 6 mesi. Resta comunque salva la possibilità di un recesso anticipato in caso di attivazione degli applicativi regionali. Si prevede inoltre un progressivo decremento dei servizi in funzione delle nuove funzionalità che verranno integrate nel SIO della Regione Veneto. Il presente contratto include in aggiunta il nuovo servizio di presidio applicativo per l’avvio della progettualità regionale LIS. Il fornitore aggiudicatario dovrà essere in grado di garantire le attività di manutenzione ed assistenza ordinaria, il rilascio degli aggiornamenti software certificati e di effettuare interventi sui moduli applicativi, conseguenti da adempimenti normativi, regionali, aziendali e/o derivanti dal collegamento di nuovi strumenti o all’informatizzazione di nuovi reparti. Lo stesso fornitore dovrà garantire il funzionamento delle integrazioni dei suddetti moduli software con gli altri sistemi aziendali. La quotazione del canone dovrà essere espressa per ogni modulo applicativo sopra evidenziato, in quanto alcuni di questi potrebbero essere dismessi a seguito dell’adozione del nuovo SIO fornito da Azienda Zero. Esigenza di approvvigionare Sistemi a Pilotaggio Remoto (SAPR) di classe Mini ad Ala Rotante in grado di assolvere compiti tecnico-operativi complessi in virtù di una molteplice dotazione di sensori installabili, di nuove tecnologie di trasmissione e di una distribuzione capillare delle informazioni. Il mandato è finalizzato all’acquisizione di: n. 115 Sistemi Aeromobili a Pilotaggio Remoto (SAPR) di classe Mini ad Ala Rotante, ciascuno comprensivo di: • n. 1 aeromobile ognuno con relativo multisensore: Elettro-ottico/Infra-Rosso/Laser Illuminator/Laser Range-Finder; • n. 1 segmento di terra completo (composto da n.2 stazioni di comando e controllo (Ground Control Station – GCS) con attrezzature/dispositivi per l’effettuazione di tutte le attività previste dai piani manutentivi di LINE (sul campo) e BASE MAINTENANCE (laboratorio); - zaini per il trasporto tattico del sistema e assistenza tecnica on-site su chiamata, per attività di manutenzione programmate e correttive sul territorio nazionale per 18 mesi; - assistenza ingegneristica finalizzata ad assicurare la sicurezza del volo ai sensi della normativa aeronautica vigente per 18 mesi; - assistenza tecnica offline; - corsi di formazione per istruttori operatori, istruttori tecnici manutentori e per operatori e description: Esigenza di approvvigionare Sistemi a Pilotaggio Remoto (SAPR) ad Ala Fissa con capacità Vertical Take Off and Landing (VTOL) in grado di assolvere compiti tecnico-operativi complessi in virtù di una molteplice dotazione di sensori installabili, di nuove tecnologie di trasmissione e di una distribuzione capillare delle informazioni. L’importo del Contratto pari a 3.073.685,77 €, comprensivo di una “quota non programmata” che sarà calcolata sulla base del ribasso della base d’asta e non potrà eccedere il limite del 20% dell’importo del contratto. L’offerta dovrà prevedere l’opzione per un importo complessivo pari al 50% dell’importo contrattuale. Pertanto, l’importo massimo dell’impresa è pari a 4.610.528,66 € (3.073.685,77 € + 1.536.842,89 €). il mandato è finalizzato all’acquisizione di: - n. 26 Sistemi Aeromobili a Pilotaggio Remoto (SAPR) di classe Micro ad Ala Fissa VTOL, ciascuno comprensivo di: o n. 2 aeromobile ognuno con relativo multisensore: Elettro-ottico/Infra-Rosso/Laser Illuminator/Laser Range-Finder; o n. 1 segmento di terra completo (composto da n.2 stazioni di comando e controllo (Ground Control Station – GCS) con simulatore embedded, apparato di comunicazione per il controllo dell’aeromobile e per la ricezione/trasmissione dei dati e delle immagini, apparati di interconnessione e alimentazione, Aircraft Ground Equipment (AGE); o un terminale radio completo aggiuntivo (per ciascun sistema) in modo da consentire l’integrazione all’interno della rete tattica dell’Esercito Italiano - attrezzature/dispositivi per l’effettuazione di tutte le attività previste dai piani manutentivi di LINE (sul campo) e BASE MAINTENANCE (laboratorio); - - zaini per il trasporto tattico del sistema e casse (tipo “peli case”) per il trasporto operativo/strategico; - - Parti di Ricambio (PdR) atte a garantire lo svolgimento di 100 ore di volo a sistema l’anno per tre anni; - - Sensori aggiuntivi per acquisizione: aerofotogrammetrica 3D, IR termografica con sensore IR, data relay in UHF; - - Manualistica d’uso e di manutenzione; - - assistenza tecnica on-site su chiamata, per attività di manutenzione programmate e correttive sul territorio nazionale per 18 mesi; - - assistenza ingegneristica finalizzata ad assicurare la sicurezza del volo ai sensi della normativa aeronautica vigente per 18 mesi; - - assistenza tecnica offline; - - corsi di formazione per istruttori operatori, istruttori tecnici manutentori e per operatori e tecnici manutentori; - - attività di Certificazione di Tipo del sistema SAPR secondo quanto previsto dalla AER(EP).P22; - - verifica del Sistema tramite prove di accertamento della vulnerabilità cyber.

Lot description: Esigenza di approvvigionare Sistemi a Pilotaggio Remoto (SAPR) ad Ala Fissa con capacità Vertical Take Off and Landing (VTOL) in grado di assolvere compiti tecnico-operativi complessi in virtù di una molteplice dotazione di sensori installabili, di nuove tecnologie di trasmissione e di una distribuzione capillare delle informazioni. L’importo del Contratto pari a 3.073.685,77 €, comprensivo di una “quota non programmata” che sarà calcolata sulla base del ribasso della base d’asta e non potrà eccedere il limite del 20% dell’importo del contratto. L’offerta dovrà prevedere l’opzione per un importo complessivo pari al 50% dell’importo contrattuale. Pertanto, l’importo massimo dell’impresa è pari a 4.610.528,66 € (3.073.685,77 € + 1.536.842,89 €). il mandato è finalizzato all’acquisizione di: - n. 26 Sistemi Aeromobili a Pilotaggio Remoto (SAPR) di classe Micro ad Ala Fissa VTOL, ciascuno comprensivo di: o n. 2 aeromobile ognuno con relativo multisensore: Elettro-ottico/Infra-Rosso/Laser Illuminator/Laser Range-Finder; o n. 1 segmento di terra completo (composto da n.2 stazioni di comando e controllo (Ground Control Station – GCS) con simulatore embedded, apparato di comunicazione per il controllo dell’aeromobile e per la ricezione/trasmissione dei dati e delle immagini, apparati di interconnessione e alimentazione, Aircraft Ground Equipment (AGE); o un terminale radio completo aggiuntivo (per ciascun sistema) in modo da consentire l’integrazione all’interno della rete tattica dell’Esercito Italiano - attrezzature/dispositivi per l’effettuazione di tutte le attività previste dai piani manutentivi di LINE (sul campo) e BASE MAINTENANCE (laboratorio); - - zaini per il trasporto tattico del sistema e casse (tipo “peli case”) per il trasporto operativo/strategico; - - Parti di Ricambio (PdR) atte a garantire lo svolgimento di 100 ore di volo a sistema l’anno per tre anni; - - Sensori aggiuntivi per acquisizione: aerofotogrammetrica 3D, IR termografica con sensore IR, data relay in UHF; - - Manualistica d’uso e di manutenzione; - - assistenza tecnica on-site su chiamata, per attività di manutenzione programmate e correttive sul territorio nazionale per 18 mesi; - - assistenza ingegneristica finalizzata ad assicurare la sicurezza del volo ai sensi della normativa aeronautica vigente per 18 mesi; - - assistenza tecnica offline; - - corsi di formazione per istruttori operatori, istruttori tecnici manutentori e per operatori e tecnici manutentori; - - attività di Certificazione di Tipo del sistema SAPR secondo quanto previsto dalla AER(EP).P22; - - verifica del Sistema tramite prove di accertamento della vulnerabilità cyber.
